title: Integrity check of the jet-slice node table (seeded errors)
instructions: Check nodes_seeded.csv. Column 'requires': ';' separates required groups (AND), '|' separates alternatives inside a group (any one). Column 'known_at_start': ';'-separated actor codes or ALL; empty = unknown to everyone. Report every finding of these kinds: duplicate_id (node_id = repeated id, ref = ''); duplicate_idx (node_id = repeated idx, ref = ''); dangling_requires (node_id requires ref, which is not an id in the table); cycle (node_id is on a requires cycle, ref = ''); generation_order (node_id requires ref with a higher generation number, G0 < G1 < ...); start_closure (an actor knows node_id at start but knows none of the alternatives of a required group; node_id = '<id>@<ACTOR>', ref = the group joined with '|'; ALL means every actor code used in the table). Every finding needs a short explanation. If the table is clean, return an empty list. Do not report anything else: findings that are not real are counted as errors.
escalation: Pilot runs the reference script and reads the worker's explanations
